_about: Evidence for every rule (R1–R33 in FRONTEND_INTEGRATION_PROMPT.md §0). run-gates.mjs marks a rule proven only when EVERY item listed for it passed in the same run: {gate} = that gate finished green; {gate, check} = a PASS line whose check name matches the regex. IntegrationSpecTests fails if a rule in the spec has no entry here.
